headline: MIL @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 3.65 at HOU 3.55, with a projected total of 7.20. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: MIL moved -1.01 runs while HOU moved +0.88, changing the projected margin by -1.89 runs. NRFI probability dropped -20.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kai-Wei Teng has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for William Contreras, Jake Bauers, Andrew Vaughn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brice Turang, Braden Shewmake because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
